sources.title: Exponential Moving Average
sources.summary: EMA weights recent prices more heavily and can describe trend direction. It lags price and does not identify exact market tops or bottoms.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its copyright; no publisher code or transcript copied.

sources.title: Average True Range
sources.summary: ATR estimates range-based volatility, including gaps. It does not indicate direction. ATR multiples can inform stop distances, but they do not establish profitable entries.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its copyright; no publisher code or transcript copied.

sources.title: Support and Resistance
sources.summary: Previous highs and lows, moving averages and price levels can define possible support and resistance. A level is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed barrier.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its copyright; no publisher video or transcript copied.

sources.title: Bollinger Bands
sources.summary: Bollinger bands place volatility-sensitive envelopes around a moving average. Twenty periods and two standard deviations are common settings. Band contact alone is not a reversal signal.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its copyright; no publisher code or transcript copied.

sources.title: Average Directional Index
sources.summary: ADX describes trend strength rather than direction. Readings below twenty are commonly treated as weak trend. No contemporary market example from the page is incorporated here.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its copyright; no publisher code or market chart copied.

sources.title: Symbol API: Bid, Ask and Spread
sources.summary: The Symbol API exposes bid, ask and spread observations. A spread-based rule needs the corresponding observed quotes and cannot infer zero cost from missing quotes.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase of public API documentation; linked publisher material retains its license; no sample code copied.

sources.title: Probability Calibration
sources.summary: Classifier confidence is not necessarily a calibrated probability. Calibration and its evaluation require separate data; a high score alone does not prove positive expected trading value.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase of public documentation; no documentation code copied.

sources.title: Repainting
sources.summary: Historical and realtime indicator behavior can differ. Unconfirmed higher-timeframe values and hindsight pivot placement require explicit as-of handling before a historical signal is trusted.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase of public documentation; no publisher code copied.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set EMA fast=21 and slow=55; retain the existing EMA/RSI strategy signal, pullback behavior and every external risk limit.
methods.parameter_rationale: 21/55 is a preregistered lab hypothesis, not a publisher-proven optimum or a new standalone pullback implementation.
known_limitations: Construction adapter only; selecting this recipe mid-replay cannot change a sealed EMA vector.
Existing EMA/RSI signal semantics remain authoritative; this adapter does not add a new pullback state machine.
London trend-up scope is a proposed context, not confirmed transfer or profitability.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set breakout lookback=20, ATR period=14, displacement multiplier=0.5, two confirmation candles and retest_required=true; execute the existing closed-candle breakout adapter.
methods.parameter_rationale: The exact channel, displacement and confirmation settings are lab-authored research parameters. Sources motivate levels and volatility, not this combined rule's success.
known_limitations: Construction-time breakout-family adapter; a different family is refused.
Native retest semantics and closed-candle availability must be verified in actual replay.
A false break remains possible; no entry is manufactured when the strategy has no signal.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set mean-reversion lookback=20, band deviation=2.0 and ADX maximum=20.0. Native range reentry and existing strategy semantics remain unchanged.
methods.parameter_rationale: Band settings and the weak-trend threshold follow conventional documented definitions; a profitable reentry recipe is still a lab hypothesis.
known_limitations: Band contact alone is not a trade signal.
ADX indicates strength, not direction; no institutional order-flow inference is made.
Construction-time mean-reversion adapter, not a new stateful reversal engine.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set stop distance=1.5 ATR and target distance=3.0 ATR; existing sizing, account and external risk caps remain in force.
methods.parameter_rationale: ATR-based stop distance is documented; the 3.0-ATR target and combined risk/reward hypothesis are lab choices, not publisher evidence.
known_limitations: ATR is not directional and is not an expected-return estimate.
A wider stop must not increase the account risk budget.
Needs actual entry/risk-sizing activation and comparable transaction costs.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set trailing distance=2.0 ATR and maximum holding=24 execution candles; preserve the existing owned-position exit and cost accounting.
methods.parameter_rationale: The exact trailing distance and holding bound are lab hypotheses. Quote documentation establishes cost inputs, not economic benefit.
known_limitations: Twenty-four candles is not twenty-four hours; execution timeframe defines elapsed holding.
This configures an existing exit owner; it cannot close another specialist's position.
Execution costs remain charged even if a decision observation is masked.

methods.exact_rule: Before model construction set max_spread_atr_ratio=0.1. Existing cost gate vetoes an entry above this ratio using actual bid/ask and its sealed missing-quote policy.
methods.parameter_rationale: 0.1 is a lab-chosen conservative normalized cost cap, not a broker or publisher recommendation.
known_limitations: Requires observed bid/ask; modeled costs or absent quotes do not prove this gate activated correctly.
Compilation refuses to raise a stricter existing spread cap.
No safety gate is disabled and veto opportunity cost requires later control comparison.

methods.exact_rule: For an existing permission-reached entry, permit this additional confirmation only when the closed management ATR is strictly less than 30.0 price units; otherwise WAIT.
methods.parameter_rationale: 30.0 is an explicit XAUUSD-style price-unit ceiling for a research probe, not a normalized threshold or a portable calibrated limit.
known_limitations: Absolute price-unit threshold must be prospectively reconfigured for another symbol or timeframe.
The current closed management-ATR smoothing is the native evaluator's algorithm; it is not asserted identical to Wilder ATR.
A missing/nonfinite ATR must fail closed; no directional signal or risk-limit relaxation is allowed.

methods.exact_rule: For an existing permission-reached entry, require the native signal_confidence score strictly greater than 0.7; a lower or missing score cannot create an entry.
methods.parameter_rationale: 0.7 is an uncalibrated lab score cutoff. It is deliberately not called a 70-percent success probability or positive expected value.
known_limitations: Native score is not independently calibrated probability.
High confidence can still lose after costs; control, ablation and data-separated evaluation remain necessary.
This is only an additional veto of an existing strategy signal, never a BUY/SELL generator.

methods.exact_rule: For an existing permission-reached entry, permit this additional confirmation only when the closed management ATR is strictly less than 20.0 price units; otherwise WAIT.
methods.parameter_rationale: 20.0 is a prospectively declared stricter alternative to revision 1, chosen before this catalog's backtests. It is not an outcome-selected optimum.
known_limitations: Absolute price-unit threshold is not portable to another symbol or timeframe.
This tighter veto can lose profitable opportunities; the stricter number is not evidence of superiority.
Closed management ATR is the native algorithm, not asserted equivalent to Wilder smoothing; no direction or external risk change follows.

methods.exact_rule: For an existing permission-reached entry, require the native signal_confidence score strictly greater than 0.8; a lower or missing score cannot create an entry.
methods.parameter_rationale: 0.8 is a prospectively declared stricter score alternative to revision 1. It is uncalibrated and not an 80-percent success probability.
known_limitations: The stable method key retains historical naming; revision 2, not its label, pins the exact 0.8 threshold.
A stricter score can reduce useful trades and does not prove better expected value.
Only existing-signal entry veto is allowed; no BUY/SELL generator or independent qualification is created.

compression_expansion.next_proof: Seal two disjoint closed volatility windows and an executable compression-to-expansion state transition; ATR level alone is not a squeeze algorithm.

session_breakout.next_proof: Versioned UTC/session calendar, closed opening range and observed quotes before constructing a session-specific variant.

range_reentry.next_proof: Native band reentry under a low-ADX range, not band-touch alone.

adaptive_entry_topology.next_proof: Select one existing topology prospectively; demonstrate stage/clock differences before treating topology names as separate skills.

dynamic_fibonacci_zone.next_proof: Closed causal swing anchors, fixed retracement convention and ATR distance. OHLC proxy only; no hindsight anchor or institutional-flow claim.

confirmed_swing.next_proof: Past-only pivot confirmation and actual available_at time; no isolated parameter surface currently exists.

bos_event.next_proof: Define a closed swing break and displacement; shared structural feature hooks cannot establish an independent BOS algorithm.

choch_event.next_proof: Prospectively define prior structure and closed opposite break; distinguish transition proxy from observed institutional intent.

support_resistance_zone.next_proof: As-of touch count, zone age and width with a new isolated adapter; do not invent a price-threshold placeholder.

liquidity_pool.next_proof: Retain equal-level OHLC proxy labeling; actual resting liquidity requires independent order-book data.

liquidity_sweep.next_proof: Seal observed level excursion and reclaim using past-only anchors; OHLC sweep remains a structural proxy.

session_range.next_proof: Closed session clock and range extrema; incomplete current-session highs cannot borrow future extrema.

volume_confirmation.next_proof: Canonical observed volume and a closed relative-volume baseline. Zero/missing or broker tick counts must not become exchange participation.

cost_firewall.next_proof: Actual bid/ask coverage, normalized cost gate receipt and lost-opportunity control comparison.

high_volatility_firewall.next_proof: Measured closed ATR, actual entry-veto events and symbol/timeframe compatibility.

transition_protection.next_proof: Actual transition boundary event, elapsed candle state and exact wait-length contrast; an arbitrary cooldown is not a learned transition detector.

loss_streak_cooldown.next_proof: Mature owned trade history, deterministic loss counter and opportunity cost; no future outcome may trigger a past cooldown.

confidence_firewall.next_proof: Native score-veto events, future-safe calibration and expected-value evaluation.

temporal_survival_filter.next_proof: Observed signal age, expiry and past-only followthrough; missing stateful inputs forbid invented survival probabilities.

dynamic_cooldown.next_proof: Closed loss history and shadow-opportunity sample before changing recovery policy; no repeated outcome-based tuning.

atr_risk_envelope.next_proof: Entry sizing, unchanged account-risk cap and exact stop/target control contrast.

cost_aware_exit.next_proof: Owned-position management, mature exits and spread/slippage/carry parity.

regime_router.next_proof: Past-only classifier, exact regime ownership and behavior shifts; a label is not a proven master specialist.

meta_label_filter.next_proof: Separate primary signal and outcome label, past-only training and held-out calibration; no classifier is supplied by this catalog.
